'''Thermal wells''' were a naturally occurring phenomenon on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. The largest and strongest thermal wells were located near [[Soco-Jarel Spaceport]], and were used by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] engaged in the recreational activity of [[thermal gliding]]. Using [[Glider (vehicle)/Legends|gliders]], pilots kept aloft by using the thermal wells to keep themselves aloft. The largest thermal wells were known to have lifted gliders up to fifteen [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] above the surface of Socorro.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
